name: DISCRETE_LLC_CONTROLLER

ports.name: I_RESONANT
ports.meaning: Resonant tank current sense signal, 0-3V proportional to primary current (from CT secondary or shunt amplifier)

ports.name: VOUT_SENSE
ports.meaning: Output voltage tap from 12V secondary rail for feedback regulation

ports.name: GATE_HI
ports.meaning: High-side gate drive signal to primary half-bridge top GaN FET (Q1)

ports.name: GATE_LO
ports.meaning: Low-side gate drive signal to primary half-bridge bottom GaN FET (Q2)

ports.name: SWITCH_NODE
ports.meaning: Half-bridge switching node (midpoint between Q1 and Q2), provides bootstrap reference for high-side driver

ports.name: ENABLE
ports.meaning: Controller enable signal, logic high = operating, logic low = shutdown (all gates off)

description: Fully discrete current-mode LLC resonant converter controller. Implements complete analog control loop with current sensing, voltage feedback (optocoupler isolated), slope compensation, VCO frequency modulation (100-500kHz), RS latch PWM generation, dead-time logic, and half-bridge gate driver. All components are JLCPCB Basic or Extended parts.
complexity: HIGH - 7 sub-circuits, analog feedback loop requiring stability analysis
critical_notes: This is the most complex block in the LLC converter
Control loop stability depends on error amplifier compensation network
Dead-time must be adequate for GaN FET switching (33ns minimum)
Bootstrap capacitor must be recharged every cycle
Slope compensation prevents sub-harmonic oscillation in current-mode control
All placeholder component values must be derived by simulator based on loop stability
